info.name: Get ERC20 token balances by wallet

params.name: address
params.description: The address from which token balances will be checked

params.name: to_block
params.description: The block number up to which the balances will be checked.

params.name: token_addresses
params.description: The addresses to get balances for (optional)

params.name: exclude_spam
params.description: Exclude spam tokens from the result

items.docs: Get an unpaginated list of token balances, without token prices, for a specific wallet address. Maximum of 2,000 tokens. Each token returned includes on-chain metadata, as well as off-chain metadata, logos, spam status and more.
